============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 839 ns | 1,192,563 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 858 ns | 1,164,916 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 88,927 ns | 11,245 | 341 | 105.99x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,497 ns | 668,026 | 803 | 1.78x slower |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,707 ns | 585,741 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 1,880 ns | 531,775 | 1.10x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 53,325 ns | 18,753 | 31.24x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,305 ns | 232,288 | 2.52x slower |

### 3. Read a Single Nested Field

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 532 ns | 1,879,748 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 49,371 ns | 20,255 | 92.80x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 3,799 ns | 263,212 | 7.14x slower |

### 4. Selective Single-Field Mutation

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,504 ns | 665,046 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 147,216 ns | 6,793 | 97.88x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 5,262 ns | 190,028 | 3.50x slower |

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 5,681 ns | 176,036 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 6,186 ns | 161,666 | 39256 | 1.09x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,221,487 ns | 819 | 39227 | 215.01x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 24,499 ns | 40,818 | 39681 | 4.31x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,964 ns | 201,445 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,238,492 ns | 807 | 249.49x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 31,163 ns | 32,089 | 6.28x slower |
